board: SainSmart 16-Channel 12V Relay Module (SKU 101-70-103) and its blue '16 Relay Module / Low-level input' clones
reason: Check passed on its 2nd run on both ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, simulator test, PCB DRC, footprint and LCSC. The pinout comes from SainSmart's own schematic: JP2 2x10 = 5V,5V / IN1..IN16 / GND,GND, plus a DC12V+/- terminal. The 5V pins are the on-board LM2576 output, so they are marked nc. The 12 V coil supply is external, 10.8-13.2 V at 600 mA. Inputs are active low. Known simulator limitation: with no 5 V logic power pin, the sim pulls the inputs up toward the 12 V supply node, while the real board pulls them through the opto LED to its own 5 V.
